body:
## What it does

Describe what you are trying to build and it returns a short list of candidate public data services from Korea's government portals. Each pick is kept brief: why it fits the idea, what sort of key or registration stands in the way, where the official docs live, and a fallback if the first one disappoints. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @reallygood83 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
